$comment: The whole pipeline is tunable from this file. Stages run in order: scout -> filter -> read -> extract -> score -> generate -> review -> publish.
$limits_comment: Scouting is free — the GitHub API costs nothing and the caps on it (perQuery, maxCandidatesPerRun) do not touch the bill. Cost is (new repos with docs) x extract, plus maxSkillsPerRun x (generate + review). maxSkillsPerRun is therefore the only cap here worth tuning for money: at 4 it was 72% of the run.

filter.$comment: Stage 2 — keep AI projects. A repo needs one strong signal, or two weak ones.

reader.$comment: Stage 3 — read documentation first. Files are tried in order; the first maxDocFiles that exist are read.

skillScoring.$comment: Stage 5 — score with rules, before any model reviews it. Weights sum to 100.

scoring.$comment: Repo-level scoring, used to rank candidates before extraction. The bias is toward things somebody BUILT — an app, a CLI, an extension you could install — over demonstrations of a technique. Systems-internals vocabulary is penalised rather than rewarded: a hand-written JIT is impressive and is not a tool.
scoring.$excludeScripts_comment: Repos whose name, description or summary is written in one of these scripts are dropped outright — an unreadable card is worse than no card. Add 'kana', 'hangul' or 'cyrillic' here to widen it.
scoring.$penalize_comment: Two families: things that aren't projects (lists, tutorials, clones), and things that are feats of engineering rather than tools (compilers, allocators, hand-written kernels).
scoring.$reward_comment: Vocabulary that shows up when somebody has shipped a thing you can install and use.
scoring.$install_comment: The clearest signal that something is a build rather than a demonstration: a line telling you how to run it. Searched across the whole README, not just the opening.

enrichment.$comment: One model per stage, matched to what the stage actually does. Extraction is bulk reading — it carries most of the input tokens and the least judgement, so it runs on the cheapest model. Generation is a writing task. Review is the gate that has to catch a fluent lie, and it is also the cheapest stage by volume, so it stays on the best model.
enrichment.$pricing_comment: Per million tokens, used to report what a run cost. Update if rates change.
